name: JL Keychain Tools
description: Save, retrieve, list and delete API keys / passwords in macOS Keychain. All entries are namespaced with the 'jl-' prefix so they don't mix with system entries.

options.label: How it works
options.description:
Save: select a value (KEY=value or just the value). If no '=', a dialog asks for a name. Names are auto-prefixed with 'jl-'.

Get: select the name, click Get. The value replaces your selection in place.

List: select any text, click List. Pick a key from the dialog. Its value replaces your original selection.

Delete: select the name, click Delete. Confirms before removing.

All entries live in the macOS login keychain, namespaced with the 'jl-' prefix so they don't mix with system entries (Wi-Fi, Safari passwords, etc.).
